instruction: 这份冲泡指南里，冰泡法（Iced Brew）漏了一步：请在 'Steep the leaves for three minutes at 80 degrees.' 和 'Refrigerate the liquor for two hours.' 这两步之间插入一行 \item Strain out the leaves. 。热泡法（Hot Brew）部分不要动——注意两种泡法里各有一句长得很像的浸泡步骤，别插错位置。

patterns: Steep the leaves for three minutes at 80 degrees
Refrigerate the liquor for two hours

assertions.literal: \item Steep the leaves for 3 minutes at 80 degrees.
